subject: Dedicated capacity topology deep-dive — resync & timezone coordination
messages:
From: Dana Li <dana@edgestream.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity deep-dive (pool sizing, autoscale, isolation)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. EdgeStream is moving from a single-model pilot to a multi-tenant serving topology and we want to do a technical deep-dive with Redwood to validate the reserved pool approach and guardrails. High-level asks: pool sizing guidance for bursty traffic, autoscale policies (latency vs. cost tradeoffs), isolation options (soft tenant QoS vs. hard isolation), and failure/fallback behavior.

Can we book a 60–75 minute architecture session in the next two weeks? Our core attendees: myself (platform lead) and Luis Gomez (infra). We are PT-based (San Francisco). Suggested windows we can open: 2027-06-21 10:00–12:00 PT or 2027-06-22 11:00–13:00 PT. If those don't work, tell me two alternatives and we will adapt.

I attached a short requirements doc with our current throughput histogram and constraints (edge-dcap-reqs.pdf).

Thanks — Dana
Dana Li
Platform Lead, EdgeStream
Dana@edgestream.io

Attachment: edge-dcap-reqs.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Hi Dana — great to hear from you and thanks for the requirements doc. Karthik (SE) and Marissa (Customer Success) will join to cover topology and ops runbook items.

We can do 60–75 minutes. Two slots that work for us this week:
- 2027-06-21 09:00–10:30 PT
- 2027-06-22 11:00–12:30 PT

If you confirm the 22nd we'll lock an architecture agenda: pool sizing model (token + concurrency inputs), autoscale knobs + SLA mapping, isolation patterns (cgroups/VMs/containerized inference), and failover to fall-back variants. I also put together a short draft agenda & shared doc (link below).

Also quick timezone check — I see your windows are PT; please confirm the timezone for Luis. If you prefer a later slot we can resync — Marissa mentioned a Friday slot next week if the above collide.

Agenda & notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1edge-dcap-notes

Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com
